AssociateAccounts.name: AssociateAccounts
AssociateAccounts.documentation:
Associates one or more member accounts with your organization's management account, enabling centralized implementation of optimization actions across those accounts. Once associated, the management account (or a delegated administrator) can apply recommended actions to the member account. When you associate a member account, its organization rule mode is automatically set to "Any allowed," which permits the management account to create Automation rules that automatically apply actions to that account. If the member account has not previously enabled the Automation feature, the association process automatically enables it.

Requests that include an account to which an organization enrollment configuration applies are rejected.

Only the management account or a delegated administrator can perform this action.

CreateAutomationRule.name: CreateAutomationRule
CreateAutomationRule.documentation: Creates a new automation rule to apply recommended actions to resources based on specified criteria.

DeleteOrganizationEnrollmentConfiguratio.name: DeleteOrganizationEnrollmentConfiguration
DeleteOrganizationEnrollmentConfiguratio.documentation:
Deletes the specified configuration types from an organization enrollment configuration. After deletion, Automation stays enabled for affected accounts and earlier account associations aren't restored. Affected accounts inherit the organization rule mode from the closest parent that has an organization enrollment configuration, or get None allowed if no parent has one.

Only the management account or a delegated administrator can perform this action.

DisassociateAccounts.name: DisassociateAccounts
DisassociateAccounts.documentation:
Disassociates member accounts from your organization's management account, removing centralized automation capabilities. Once disassociated, organization rules no longer apply to the member account, and the management account (or delegated administrator) can't create automation rules for that account.

Requests that include an account to which an organization enrollment configuration applies are rejected.

Only the management account or a delegated administrator can perform this action.

GetAutomationEvent.name: GetAutomationEvent
GetAutomationEvent.documentation: Retrieves details about a specific automation event.

GetAutomationRule.name: GetAutomationRule
GetAutomationRule.documentation: Retrieves details about a specific automation rule.

GetEnrollmentConfiguration.name: GetEnrollmentConfiguration
GetEnrollmentConfiguration.documentation: Retrieves the current enrollment configuration for Compute Optimizer Automation.

ListAccounts.name: ListAccounts
ListAccounts.documentation:
Lists the accounts in your organization that are enrolled in Compute Optimizer and whether they have enabled Automation.

Only the management account or a delegated administrator can perform this action.

ListAutomationEventSteps.name: ListAutomationEventSteps
ListAutomationEventSteps.documentation: Lists the steps for a specific automation event. You can only list steps for events created within the past year.

ListAutomationEventSummaries.name: ListAutomationEventSummaries
ListAutomationEventSummaries.documentation: Provides a summary of automation events based on specified filters. Only events created within the past year will be included in the summary.

ListAutomationEvents.name: ListAutomationEvents
ListAutomationEvents.documentation: Lists automation events based on specified filters. You can retrieve events that were created within the past year.

ListAutomationRulePreview.name: ListAutomationRulePreview
ListAutomationRulePreview.documentation: Returns a preview of the recommended actions that match your Automation rule's configuration and criteria.

ListAutomationRulePreviewSummaries.name: ListAutomationRulePreviewSummaries
ListAutomationRulePreviewSummaries.documentation: Returns a summary of the recommended actions that match your rule preview configuration and criteria.

ListAutomationRules.name: ListAutomationRules
ListAutomationRules.documentation: Lists the automation rules that match specified filters.

ListOrganizationEnrollmentConfigurations.name: ListOrganizationEnrollmentConfigurations
ListOrganizationEnrollmentConfigurations.documentation:
Lists the organization enrollment configurations that are stored directly on accounts, organizational units (OUs), and the organization root.

Only the management account or a delegated administrator can perform this action.

ListOrganizationalUnits.name: ListOrganizationalUnits
ListOrganizationalUnits.documentation:
Lists the organization root and organizational units (OUs), including whether an applicable organization enrollment configuration enables Automation for member accounts and the effective organization rule mode for each root or OU.

Only the management account or a delegated administrator can perform this action.

ListRecommendedActionSummaries.name: ListRecommendedActionSummaries
ListRecommendedActionSummaries.documentation:
Provides a summary of recommended actions based on specified filters.

Management accounts and delegated administrators can retrieve recommended action summaries for member accounts that are associated using AssociateAccounts or have an applicable organization enrollment configuration with organizationRuleMode set to AnyAllowed.

ListRecommendedActions.name: ListRecommendedActions
ListRecommendedActions.documentation:
Lists the recommended actions that match the specified filters.

Management accounts and delegated administrators can retrieve recommended actions for member accounts that are associated using AssociateAccounts or have an applicable organization enrollment configuration with organizationRuleMode set to AnyAllowed.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation: Lists the tags for a specified resource.

PutOrganizationEnrollmentConfiguration.name: PutOrganizationEnrollmentConfiguration
PutOrganizationEnrollmentConfiguration.documentation:
Creates or updates an organization enrollment configuration. The organization enrollment configuration sets the organization rule mode on the specified account, organizational unit (OU), or organization root and enables Automation for affected member accounts that have opted in to Compute Optimizer, including accounts that join later. Changes on an OU or the organization root can take up to 5 minutes. Organization enrollment configurations take precedence over settings made by AssociateAccounts and DisassociateAccounts. You must specify at least one configuration in the request.

Only the management account or a delegated administrator can perform this action.

Organization enrollment configurations can't be created for the management account.

RollbackAutomationEvent.name: RollbackAutomationEvent
RollbackAutomationEvent.documentation:
Initiates a rollback for a completed automation event.

Management accounts and delegated administrators can initiate a rollback for events belonging to member accounts that are associated using AssociateAccounts or have an applicable organization enrollment configuration with organizationRuleMode set to AnyAllowed.

StartAutomationEvent.name: StartAutomationEvent
StartAutomationEvent.documentation:
Initiates a one-time, on-demand automation for the specified recommended action.

Management accounts and delegated administrators can initiate recommended actions for member accounts that are associated using AssociateAccounts or have an applicable organization enrollment configuration with organizationRuleMode set to AnyAllowed.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.documentation: Adds tags to the specified resource.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.documentation: Removes tags from the specified resource.

UpdateEnrollmentConfiguration.name: UpdateEnrollmentConfiguration
UpdateEnrollmentConfiguration.documentation: Updates your account’s Compute Optimizer Automation enrollment configuration.

OrganizationConfiguration.documentation: Configuration settings that define the scope of an organization-wide automation rule. Each organizational unit (OU) list can contain up to 150 OUs or organization roots, and each account list can contain up to 50 accounts. Each included OU or organization root must have an effective organization rule mode of AnyAllowed. Exclusions take precedence over inclusions. An account that is in an included OU and is also excluded is excluded. The rule doesn't apply to the management account when the account is reached through an OU or the organization root.

sourceType.documentation:
How the effective organization rule mode is supplied.

  • Applied - An organization enrollment configuration is on this organizational unit or account.

  • Inherited - The organization enrollment configuration is on the parent organizational unit or root.

  • Direct - The organization rule mode is set on the account itself, with no organization enrollment configuration applied.

  • Default - No organization enrollment configuration applies, so the organization rule mode is None allowed.

autoEnrollMemberAccounts.documentation:
Whether an applicable organization enrollment configuration enables Automation for eligible member accounts beneath the organizational unit (OU) or organization root.

  • All - An organization enrollment configuration applies and enables Automation for affected member accounts, including accounts that join later. This value applies to configurations with either AnyAllowed or NoneAllowed.

  • None - No organization enrollment configuration applies, so Automation isn't enabled by an organization enrollment configuration.

name.documentation: The name of the filter field to apply.

values.documentation:
The list of values to filter by for the specified filter name. Wildcards aren't supported. An asterisk (*) or a question mark (?) in a value matches only that literal character. How a value is matched depends on the filter name:

ResourceType, RecommendedActionType, ResourceId, and AccountId

The value that you specify must exactly match the corresponding field of the recommended action, including case. For example, specify EbsVolume, not ebsvolume.

CurrentResourceDetailsEbsVolumeType

Matches when the value appears anywhere in the current resource details of the recommended action, which include the volume type, size, IOPS, and throughput. Matching is case sensitive, and a partial value also matches. For example, gp matches both gp2 and gp3 volumes, and 100 matches any volume whose size, IOPS, or throughput contains 100. To filter by volume type, specify the complete volume type, such as gp3 or io2.

ResourceTagsKey and ResourceTagsValue

Matches when the value appears anywhere in the tags of the resource. Both filter names search every tag key and tag value. Matching is case sensitive, and a partial value also matches. For example, a ResourceTagsKey value of test matches a resource that has a tag value of test.

LookBackPeriodInDays

Matches when the lookback period of the recommended action equals the value. Specify a number of days, such as 14.

RestartNeeded

Matches recommended actions based on whether implementing them requires a resource restart. Specify true or false.

If a filter has more than one value, a recommended action matches the filter when it matches any of the values. If you specify more than one filter, a recommended action must match all of the filters.

The expression that defines when the schedule runs. cron expression is supported. A cron expression consists of six fields separated by white spaces: (minutes hours day_of_month month day_of_week year)

You can schedule rules to run at most once per day. Your cron expression must use specific values (not wildcards) for the minutes and hours fields. For example: (30 12 * * *) runs daily at 12:30 PM UTC.

status.documentation:
The desired enrollment status.

  • Active - Enables the Automation feature for your account.

  • Inactive - Disables the Automation feature for your account and stops all of your automation rules. If you opt in again later, all rules will be inactive, and you must enable the rules you want to run. You must wait at least 24 hours after opting out to opt in again.

The Pending and Failed options can't be used to update the enrollment status of an account. They are returned in the response of a request to update the enrollment status of an account.

If you are a member account, you can't disable Automation while an organization enrollment configuration applies. If no organization enrollment configuration applies, you also can't disable Automation while your organization rule mode is AnyAllowed. Ask your administrator to delete the organization enrollment configuration or disassociate your account, as applicable.

documentation: Automation is a feature within Amazon Web Services Compute Optimizer that enables you to apply optimization recommendations to your Amazon Web Services resources, reducing costs and improving performance. You can apply recommended actions directly or create automation rules that implement recommendations on a recurring schedule when they match your specified criteria. With automation rules, set criteria such as Amazon Web Services Region and Resource Tags to target specific geographies and workloads. Configure rules to run daily, weekly, or monthly, and Compute Optimizer continuously evaluates new recommendations against your criteria. Track automation events over time, examine detailed step history, estimate savings achieved, and reverse actions directly from Compute Optimizer when needed.
